sections.title: **1. Condition Description**
sections.text: During routine surveillance, AFW Pump P-101A exhibited elevated vibration after start. Vibration channel VB-101A peaked at 6.2 mils (alarm setpoint 5.0 mils) with stable flow at 465 gpm and discharge pressure at 1175 psig. No bearing temperature alarms were observed.

sections.title: **2. Immediate Actions**
sections.text: Operator stopped P-101A within 2 minutes of alarm. Control Room notified. Train A declared inoperable pending evaluation. Condition entered into the corrective action program.

sections.title: **3. Operability / Safety Significance**
sections.text: AFW Train B remained available. No safety injection or reactor trip occurred. This CR is categorized as low safety significance for training/test purposes.
